warnings.warning: The body accepts CR below 0.01 while the appendix code uses 0.10; internal AHP consistency does not establish classification accuracy.
The overlap denominator uses undeclared L, whereas the following simplification substitutes L_major; equivalence requires an unstated identity.
The regression is fit to five visually selected leaf-tree pairs and is reported without intervals, residual checks, or selection-independent validation.
The moderate-hardwood quadratic is labeled as the fast-growing function in the prose, so equation-to-stratum reuse must follow the plotted legend rather than the sentence.
The printed exponent sign conflicts with the stated saturating growth interpretation unless k2 is negative; the claimed inverse and six constants are not derived or fitted.

global_organization_chain: Introduction turns visible leaf variation into classification, distribution, profile, and total-mass questions
Breaking Down the Problem orders four deliverables and names their intermediate variables
Assumptions bounds the population, geometry, causal mechanisms, and biological state
Nomenclatures defines image, overlap, mass, sequestration, and age variables
Model One maps images through seven descriptors and AHP weights to a prototype class
Model Two maps leaf geometry and branch spacing through overlap to a latitude comparison
Model Three transfers shape descriptors to five leaf-tree pairs and runs three regressions
Model Four maps age and tree type through sequestration to leaf mass and separately to tree size
Testing sections expose worked examples, external ranges, regressions, and source-table fits
Model conclusions retain database, mixed-test, and identifiability boundaries
Strengths and Weaknesses reviews each model in the same sequence
The editor letter reorganizes the three cross-object findings for a nontechnical audience
The appendix exposes the type lookup and code paths used by AHP, image measurement, and regression

main_argument_chains.claim: Interpretable image descriptors can support prototype leaf classification.
support_steps: Measure seven geometric descriptor groups from a segmented leaf image.
Use AHP weights to combine squared deviations from six prototypes.
Assign the worked maple leaf to the minimum-score category.
Limit the evidence to one anticipated example and six prototype classes.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use the feature pipeline as an inspectable baseline, not as a validated general classifier.

main_argument_chains.claim: Leaf distribution, leaf shape, and solar altitude are linked through an idealized overlap model.
support_steps: Define a two-leaf branch geometry and three solar-altitude regimes.
Use major-axis length and internode spacing to express overlap.
Transform three measured cases into predicted latitudes.
Compare predictions with broad reference ranges while retaining the symbol and sampling limits.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat the model as a mechanism sketch requiring measured overlap validation.

main_argument_chains.claim: Selected leaf-shape and tree-profile descriptors show mixed association.
support_steps: Merge the source classes into five visually paired leaf-tree types.
Transfer rectangularity, aspect ratio, and circularity to tree silhouettes.
Fit three n=5 regressions and run F-tests.
Carry the failed rectangularity result with the two supporting results into the conclusion.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Preserve the mixed exploratory result and require independently sampled pairs before prediction.

main_argument_chains.claim: Tree age can mediate separate proxy estimates of leaf mass and tree size.
support_steps: Convert sequestration mass to leaf mass using a type-specific ability factor.
Fit age-stratified sequestration curves from the DOE table.
Select a qualitative growth family for age-to-size behavior.
Expose that the final endpoint relation shares age but lacks fitted growth constants and joint calibration.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Retain the two handoffs as a qualitative dependency chain, not a calibrated leaf-mass/tree-size predictor.

visualization_dispositions.analytical_purpose: A visually rich leaf montage establishes the object but supplies no analytical information.
Bounding geometry is overlaid directly on source leaves beside equations.
A mechanism sketch identifies sunlight, shaded leaf, branch, and solar angle.
Raw points and fit lines are visible, but intervals, residuals, sample size labels, and aligned statistics are absent.
A dependency diagram makes the age and sequestration handoffs visible but does not distinguish calibrated from qualitative edges.
